tokens.name: space-darkBlue
tokens.usage: The page. `body` paints it and every card, panel and dropdown sits on it, usually at 60% alpha over the star field. Also the ink on mint, violet and gold fills.

tokens.name: space-lightGray
tokens.usage: Primary text: h1-h3, card titles, nav items, form values. 13.5:1 on space-darkBlue.

tokens.name: space-gray
tokens.usage: Body copy, card descriptions, meta rows, footer links. 6.1:1 on space-darkBlue.

tokens.name: space-blue
tokens.usage: The brand blue. Accent word in section headings, icons, the primary CTA fill, and every hairline border at 10-30% alpha. 7.2:1 as text on space-darkBlue. As a fill it is paired with white in the codebase, which is only 2.6:1 - see Colour in the brand book.

tokens.name: space-gold
tokens.usage: The brand gold. Hero tagline, the secondary outline CTA, and the simulated-demo notice. 8.3:1 as text on space-darkBlue. Pair fills with space-darkBlue, never white.

tokens.name: space-lightBlue
tokens.usage: Mint. The STELLAR-SCAN demo accent, the service-card hover sheen and the orbit rings. 15.2:1 as text on space-darkBlue; as a fill it takes space-darkBlue text.

tokens.name: space-purple
tokens.usage: Violet. The COSMOS-SENTIMENT demo accent only. 7.0:1 as text on space-darkBlue; as a fill it takes space-darkBlue text.

tokens.name: space-lightGreen
tokens.usage: Positive signal inside demo result panels (a passing check, a positive sentiment bar). Never a lone hue: pair it with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The shadcn page surface. Input fills and the outline Button resolve to it. Note it is #14161a, a step lighter than space-darkBlue, which is what `body` actually paints.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn default text. Only the outline Badge and file inputs reach it; the site's own text uses space-lightGray.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Fill of an unstyled Card. Most of the site overrides it with space-darkBlue at 60% alpha.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside an unstyled Card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Fill of Popover, DropdownMenu and Tooltip surfaces.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The shadcn primary. #00aceb - a second, more saturated blue than space-blue. Default Button and Badge fills use it; brand CTAs override to space-blue. Pick one per surface and stay with it.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary. 3.2:1 - large or bold text only, which is what a 14px semibold button label just about is. Prefer space-darkBlue on light-blue fills.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button and Badge fill: a quiet raised step above the page.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary. 14.6:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Muted surface; same value as secondary.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: CardDescription and input placeholders. 7.4:1 on background.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The shadcn accent, the HSL sibling of space-gold. Ghost and outline Button hover fills.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent. 2.4:1 - it fails on a solid accent fill; the codebase only uses the pair on hover states at low alpha.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Error toasts and the destructive Button. Deliberately dark so white text reads: 7.0:1.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The global border colour applied to every element by the `*` rule in src/index.css. Brand surfaces override it with space-blue at 10-30% alpha.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input and Textarea border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The default focus ring, 2px with a 2px offset. 10.3:1 on space-darkBlue. Demo surfaces swap it for their own accent.

families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The homepage h1 at md and up. Set in space-blue, typed out character by character.

styles.name: display-demo
styles.usage: A demo page's codename at md and up, filled with the demo's accent gradient.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section h2 at md and up. First word or phrase in space-blue or space-gold, the rest in space-lightGray.

styles.name: hero-tagline
styles.usage: The gold line under the hero h1, at md and up.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: CardTitle. Tight leading because it usually runs to one or two words.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: BlogCard headline and panel h3 inside Card.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: The heading over a secondary block, such as Keep exploring on a demo page.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The paragraph under a section title and the hero intro. Always space-gray, capped at 3xl width.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy and mobile nav items.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: CardDescription, blog excerpts, notice text, the Textarea.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, desktop nav items and Button text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Read time, dates, counts, the Demo N of M chip.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set uppercase. The label above a demo hero and the codename on a switcher tile; always in the surface's accent colour.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badge text. Never set uppercase - categories keep their own casing.

styles.name: mono-note
styles.usage: The only monospace on the site: the requested path echoed on the 404 page.

spacing.note: The Tailwind 4px scale. Only the steps the site actually reaches for are listed.

tokens.name: spacing-1
tokens.usage: Gap between tag pills; the 1px-scale nudges inside meta rows.

tokens.name: spacing-1.5
tokens.usage: Dropdown menu padding; the vertical padding of a feature chip.

tokens.name: spacing-2
tokens.usage: Tag pill padding, icon-to-label gap, mobile nav row padding.

tokens.name: spacing-2.5
tokens.usage: Chip row gaps and dropdown item padding.

tokens.name: spacing-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrow and meta chip horizontal padding; Input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: spacing-4
tokens.usage: The page gutter (`px-4`), notice padding, the gap between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: spacing-5
tokens.usage: DoneStrip padding and demo switcher tile padding.

tokens.name: spacing-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on every side. CardContent and CardFooter drop the top.

tokens.name: spacing-8
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards, the padding of a full-width panel Card, container padding at the 2xl breakpoint.

tokens.name: spacing-10
tokens.usage: Footer column block above the legal rule.

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: Footer vertical padding; the CTA panel at md and up.

tokens.name: spacing-16
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading block and the grid under it.

tokens.name: spacing-20
tokens.usage: Standard section rhythm: every homepage section is `py-20`.

tokens.name: spacing-24
tokens.usage: The bottom of a demo page, before the footer.

radius.note: `--radius` is 0.5rem; sm and md are derived from it. The larger steps are Tailwind's own, used by the demo surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The smallest step. Tag pills and inline code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Button, Input, Textarea, nav items, dropdown rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Card, the testimonial panel, and any image that fills a card's top edge.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Demo surfaces: the simulated-demo notice, the DoneStrip, the switcher tiles.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The largest rectangle: the CTA panel and the icon tile beside a demo codename.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, Badge, icon circles, the scroll-to-top button, social buttons.

shadow.note: The site leans on borders and glows rather than drop shadows. Two real shadows, then the accent glows that sit under a demo CTA.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Card's own shadow. Nearly invisible on space-darkBlue, which is the point: the border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The floating scroll-to-top button, the only element that sits above the page.

tokens.name: glow-blue
tokens.usage: Under a space-blue CTA on a demo page.

tokens.name: glow-mint
tokens.usage: Under a mint CTA on the STELLAR-SCAN page.

tokens.name: glow-violet
tokens.usage: Under a violet CTA on the COSMOS-SENTIMENT page.

layout.note: Widths the shell and its sections are actually built to.

tokens.name: shell-max
tokens.usage: The navbar's inner width (`max-w-7xl`).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: A demo page's content column (`max-w-6xl`).

tokens.name: panel-max
tokens.usage: The testimonial and contact panels (`max-w-4xl`).

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: A section heading block and its lead paragraph (`max-w-3xl`). Keeps the measure readable.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: The Tailwind container's 2xl screen.

tokens.name: navbar-height
tokens.usage: The fixed navbar (`h-20`). Page content starts at `pt-32` so it clears.

opacity.note: The alpha steps the brand surfaces are built from. Applied to space-blue for borders and to space-darkBlue for fills.

tokens.name: alpha-hairline
tokens.usage: The faintest rule: the divider inside a BlogCard.

tokens.name: alpha-border
tokens.usage: The default border on a card, panel or the navbar: space-blue at 20%.

tokens.name: alpha-border-strong
tokens.usage: A border that is meant to be seen: the notice, a demo icon tile, social buttons.

tokens.name: alpha-tint
tokens.usage: An accent used as a fill behind an icon: space-blue at 10% in a 48px circle.

tokens.name: alpha-surface
tokens.usage: space-darkBlue behind a card, so the star field reads through the blur.

tokens.name: alpha-hover-border
tokens.usage: A card's border on hover.
